name: Bare-stemmed tick-trefoil
desc: Bare-stemmed tick-trefoil (Hylodesmum nudiflorum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hylodesmum nudiflorum, the naked-flowered tick trefoil, panicled leaf tick trefoil or stemless tick trefoil, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae, native to eastern North America.
